text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the new year, I held my breath alongside Gran Alegria
as we watched the special TV broadcast—

text_block_list.name: Special Program Narration
text_block_list.text:
"—We have a breaking announcement from the URA!
Last year's Umamusume of the Year is...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Program Narration
text_block_list.text: ‘It's Almond Eye!!’

text_block_list.name: Special Program Narration
text_block_list.text: "Claiming victory in the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho to achieve the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Special Program Narration
text_block_list.text: "In the subsequent Japan Cup, she claimed victory with a world record!"

text_block_list.name: Special Program Narration
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to her brilliant track record,
she has won the award by a unanimous vote!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai's world record!
Seriously, it was pure excitement, infinity miles long!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up with the leader who tried to pull away at the 3rd corner,
she made a brilliant sweep to overtake them on the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That finishing burst gave even me
0.01 miles of goosebumps!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She ran with such an unbothered expression, yet when we looked at the time, it was a world record.
That moment was utterly shocking...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply honored to be chosen as Umamusume of the Year.
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I just kept running, refusing to lose to anyone,
and receiving this award serves as proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I won't lose from here on out, either!
This year, I'm going to surpass who I was last year!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Looks like Ai-senpai is taking on an overseas GⅠ next. Was it Dubai, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'll run in Japanese races too.
I want to race with Eye-senpai as well!
choice_data_list: Then first up is the Oka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: You're right! I'll surpass last year's Ai-senpai and—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll gladly let you celebrate
the coronation of the true Mile Queen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye and Gran Alegria.
Two miraculous talents, competing side-by-side.
choice_data_list: (Historically speaking, aren't we living in an incredible era?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, have you started
your personal rules for the year yet?
choice_data_list: Starting with My Rule?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's my personal rule at the start of every year.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I make it a point to start with personal rules
that lead to my guidelines and goals for the year.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If you haven't yet, would you like to do it now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see, that might be a good idea.
As a guiding principle for this year, the first custom I'll adopt is—
choice_data_list: Greet the track
Eat something nutritious
Do the first calligraphy of the new year

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Greeting the track...?
choice_data_list: So that I can face it with a sincere heart.
So that I can face it with a sincere heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The track is an indispensable place
where Umamusume train.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wishing for them to run without getting injured,
I make sure to greet them with all the sincerity
and dedication of a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is that so!
I'm thoroughly impressed by your 15 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Let's do this right away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
May I run safely throughout this entire year.
I'm counting on you again this year!
choice_data_list: Please...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we bowed deeply to the track.
It really makes you straighten your spine...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
The person on the turf course is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Blast-senpai!
Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Gran!
You too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Blast Onepiece,
an Umamusume who loves humans.
choice_data_list: What were you doing crouched down like that?
What were you doing crouching down?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'm picking up rocks!
It'd be dangerous if someone kicked one while running.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The maintenance crew gets time off during New Year's, right?
So I'm filling in for 'em!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Picking up trash... makes me feel like
I understand the maintenance crew a little better!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone can run safely... Thinking that
gives me the resolve not to let a single stone slip by.
choice_data_list: A sense of duty... something like that, I guess
A sense of duty... something like that, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'll fire up and say, "It's my mission!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The maintenance staff's sense of mission...!
Somehow, the 24 Miles sounds incredible!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'll help pick up rocks too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure the Umamusume can run safely.
The maintenance staff share that exact same sentiment.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ohh, thanks to both of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with gratitude and respect—
I picked up stones with a solemn heart.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is that right!
Well then, let's go grab a bite!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On my way to the school gate, I ran into Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai,
congratulations on winning Horse of the Year!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you.
...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Are you feeling a little tired?
About one mile's worth.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
! That's not true at all.
I'm full of energy, as always!
choice_data_list: ...Gran. Is it okay if we change our plans to eat out?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
? Yes.
Since it's the start of your house rules, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What is this...?
choice_data_list: Something nutritious—amazake, of course

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they call it an "IV drip in a drink," don't they?
Did you make it yourself?
choice_data_list: It's just the perfect companion for work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If the Trainer collapses, they can't support their Umamusume. I always keep sake lees on hand to make amazake.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This amazake is so easy to drink!
It's not overpowering at all... and it tastes nutty!
choice_data_list: I mixed in almond milk
I mixed in some almond milk

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...It's sweet and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I've still got a long way to go, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even though Gran-chan and the others take
such thorough care of their physical condition...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: To think I hadn't even prepared a way to control my own mind...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for helping me
realize my shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll treat you to a drink
that's even more nutritious!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Well then, excuse me.
choice_data_list: ...Did they just get all competitive with me?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Aha, that's so like Ai-senpai!
Not wanting to lose
even to a specialist Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Still, isn't it fine?!
It looks like she's cheered up, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "It suits Ai-senpai much better to be fiery and determined not to lose!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's a classic! All right,
let's head to the gym!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the start of the year, the gymnasium
is opened up for Kakizome—the first calligraphy of the year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since our students took part in the "New Year Calligraphy Performance,"
more and more voices have expressed a desire to try Kakizome.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you all gonna do
first calligraphy of the year too, Gran-chan?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Have you decided what you're going to write, Lala-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Not yet. Would it be alright if I learned a bit from Gran-chan and the others?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All doooone!
Trainer, how does it look!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria's calligraphy read "Three Distance Classes Conquered".
However, seemingly running out of space, the character "Conquered" was written on a separate sheet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And what's more, it's written in katakana, not kanji.
choice_data_list: T-That's novel, all right. I can sense the artistry...!
T-That's novel, all right. I can sense the artistry...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Oh, it's nothing, really!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, making "Domination" bigger than "Triple Crown"
might make it look 5 miles tougher, don't you think?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it definitely looks like it might be strong?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this time
I'll write the ultimate version!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's ready!
8 Mile looks super strong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This time, it fit onto a single sheet of calligraphy paper.
A modest "Triple Weight Class" and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The powerful word: "Conquest."
choice_data_list: Yeah, this looks insanely strong in its own right!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......No, for real.
You two make such a great duo.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're making me blush~♪
Was that helpful to you, Lala-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's true... Guess it makes sense for me to follow Gran-chan and the others' lead.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
But...
...it really is quite a dilemma.
